source.title: The Wild Gods
source.description:
Somethin' be wrong with de loa of Hyjal. De most powerful spirits of nature have been watchin' over the mountain for thousands of years, but dey be startin' to vanish, one by one.

Agamaggan, de greatest of de ancient loa, died long ago. But de Amani trolls have ways to speak with de dead. Find de voodoo dey be usin', and take it to de Razorfen. Talk to Agamaggan and ask him what be happenin' to his kin.
source.objective: Collect a Wildwhisper Draught from Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands, then use it at the top of Razorfen Downs to speak to the Spirit of Agamaggan.
source.completion:
Even beyond the veil of death, I have sensed a shadow falling across Hyjal and my kin.

Take this, mortal. You will need it for what is to come.
